description: Strict, evidence-only runtime GPU input coverage for the active Kestron GameUber programs. Unknown live values are deliberately not defaulted or fitted.

game_prepass_archive.container_match_rule: each decoded container must occur once at its declared archive offset

rules.exact: literal archive/BFRES/decompiler/decoder data or arithmetic derived solely from it
rules.unresolved: a required live word/texel whose target producer contents have not been recovered
forbidden_substitutions: identity matrices not written by a recovered constructor
white/black dummy frame textures without a proven binding
shader defaults absent from the active BFRES without a recovered initializer

constant_buffer_sources.name: GameUberEmbeddedFragmentConstants
constant_buffer_sources.binding_evidence: each selected fragment ShaderCode stream1 ends with a 0x100-byte bank whose nonzero prefix exactly covers that program's decoded cbuf1 reads
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: none: copy the exact final 0x100 bytes of the selected tools/_shader_work/<key>.bnsh_fsh
constant_buffer_sources.rejected_source: the separate 0x100-byte zero BinaryProgram.MemoryData object and FUN_71017c4cfc scene payload do not match the nonzero per-program cbuf1 read constants

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_context
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: capture every decoder-observed Context word separately for each stage immediately before the selected GameUber draw; allocation bytes that neither selected stage reads are not title-value inputs and are never represented as recovered values

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_skeleton
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: capture Mtx bytes bound as Maxwell cbuf5 immediately before the draw

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_shape
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: capture every decoder-observed ShpMtx word for each stage after shape/bone setup and immediately before the draw

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_environment
constant_buffer_sources.runtime_owner: selected environment and frame lighting state
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: capture the complete Env allocation bound as Maxwell cbuf9 immediately before draw; complete capture is required while decoded reads remain runtime-indexed

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_material
constant_buffer_sources.runtime_owner: active BFRES material serialization plus runtime overrides
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: for any absent/volatile word, capture the Mat allocation bound as Maxwell cbuf11 after material overrides

constant_buffer_sources.name: gsys_user1
constant_buffer_sources.capture_boundary: capture every decoder-observed GlobalUBO word separately for each stage immediately before the selected draw

runtime_object_fields.value_status: derived by the selected camera-mode branch; not materialized here

producer_trace.name: apply_resolved_snapshot_camera
producer_trace.role: write inherited resource parameters to runtime offsets +0x444..+0x47f

producer_trace.name: populate_snapshot_scene_state_from_resolved_camera_and_lighting
producer_trace.role: consume those runtime fields and call the look-at, affine-inverse, and contextual direction helpers

target_mapping.status: no recovered serializer or binder proves byte equivalence between this runtime object and GameUber Context, Env, or GlobalUBO

mii_icon_snapshot_camera_source.rejected_defaults: unselected PlaceByMii/MiiTouch camera catalogs and reference-image-fitted matrices

separate_mii_icon_scene_payload.binding_status: not GameUber fragment cbuf1; retained only as separately recovered scene/prepass evidence

archive.container_match_rule: each decoded container must occur once at its declared archive offset

stages.selection_boundary: This is the all-zero/default archive variation; no runtime evidence selects it for Kestron.

content_producers_proven: PreShading fragment writes frag_color0 RGB lighting and frag_color1 auxiliary output.
Point, spot, and area-environment fragments compute additive light RGB.
The decoded default ShadowPrePass fragment combines the shadow sample with cClearColor.
unresolved: attachment routing from prepass outputs to gsys_light_prepass/gsys_shadow_prepass
clear values and clear call sites
draw lists and exact per-light records

decoder_emulation_cbuf1.classification: BNSH branch-table/threshold literals surfaced by the Maxwell decoder; not a frame-owned Mii layer UBO bound by FUN_7101d78e10

producer_layout.evidence: FUN_7101d71620 writes selector then calls FUN_7100ba7910 three times; each call copies source xyz and explicitly writes destination w=0x3f800000

fragment_layer_cbuf3.branch_policy: only words read by the selected native branch are execution requirements; words referenced solely by inactive decoded branches remain visibly unresolved and are not defaulted

exact_intermediate_base_projection.warning: this is input to FUN_7101d76bf0, not the final uploaded per-layer matrix

ledger.unknown_fragment_byte_policy: the selected decoded branch does not read mask-zero bytes; a backend must validate the known mask before uploading the host-materialized data

native_execution_provenance.callback_boundary: only the Mii render-resource accessor vtable and color lookups are replaced; geometry answers are checked against exact target/resource bytes, while color scratch is varied and proven not to affect any vertex payload

selected_part_axes.provenance: selected Parts BGYML has no origin override; get_mii_part_origin returns the zero-initialized resource default

sampler.binder: FUN_7101d78e10 binds the selected layer texture/sampler through handle field +0x58
sampler.case21_dummy_binding: FUN_7101d88f98 resolves Dummy_Alb, stores its resource pointer at owner+0x1f8, creates the live draw resource at owner+0x98, then copies Dummy_Alb resource+0x90 into live draw resource+0x5f8; FUN_7101d78e10 binds that +0x5f8 view for case21

quad_mesh.gpu_binding: FUN_7101d78e10 binds vertex stream 0, index stream 1, then issues the indexed draw

case21_fullscreen_quad.constructor_path: FUN_7101d719c0 initializes the embedded sprite mesh at generated-atlas object+0xa0; FUN_7101d78e10 selects exactly that object+0xa0 mesh for case21
case21_fullscreen_quad.coverage: full 256x256 target under the exact identity vertex matrix

quad_mesh.status: literal CPU streams and indexed draw arguments resolved exactly

case21.submission_proof: FUN_7101d786e0 calls FUN_7101d78e10(...,0x15,0) unconditionally. In case21, FUN_7101d78e10 selects the embedded +0xa0 mesh, initializes the texture from live draw resource+0x5f8, sets bVar1=true, and continues when FUN_7101d72d04 returns null before issuing the indexed draw. There is no case21 pass1 call.

runtime_payload.producer: FUN_7101d75d68 zeros the case21 selector and all three source float3 colors; FUN_7101d71620 calls FUN_7100ba7910, which copies xyz and explicitly writes w=1.0
runtime_payload.unknown_fragment_byte_policy: only selector padding +0x04/+0x08/+0x0c is unclaimed; the selector==0 early shader path reads +0x00 and C1 +0x10..+0x1c only

fragment_shader_path.instructions: selector zero takes the initial predicated MOV C1.r/g/b/a path and branches to the shared epilogue before TEXS or the BRX jump table

case21.fragment_colors: three source float3 zero vectors, each packed with exact alpha 1.0

sampler_texture.name: Dummy_Alb
sampler_texture.producer: FUN_7101d88f98 Dummy_Alb lookup -> resource+0x90 -> live draw resource+0x5f8 -> FUN_7101d78e10 local_48

blend_result.full_target_effect: replace with opaque black before pass1

base_texture_and_sample_view.effect: later sampling performs hardware sRGB decode for RGB; alpha remains linear

mii_mask_color_target_view.effect: MiiMask numeric shader outputs are written directly without an sRGB encode

storage_and_view_formats.exact_trace: FUN_7101d7a3cc/FUN_7101d7a504 read the two target formats through FUN_7100ba6eac/FUN_7100ba6eb4, pass 0x0b06 through FUN_7100ba6e40, which rewrites low byte 6 to 1, then FUN_7101d6fc7c/FUN_7101d71744 call FUN_7100604508; FUN_71006046cc dispatches nvnTextureViewSetFormat

native_constructor_evidence.warning: 0x0b01 is the request-config default, not the live faceline/mask target format

clear.mii_mask_epilogue: discard alpha-zero output for every selector except 9
clear.case21_descriptor: selector/color source RGB zero and identity transform; FUN_7100ba7910 forces packed C1.a to 1.0, so the later case21 fullscreen draw replaces the transparent clear with opaque black before pass1

submitted_draw_instances.proof: the checked Normal-expression active-layer ledger resolves exactly seven gated resource cases; FUN_7101d78e10 applies the same gates in both passes, while case21 is the sole fallback-allowed unconditional pass0 draw

target.content_path: FUN_7101d786e0 -> FUN_7101d78e10 for each gated case

downstream_gameuber_sampler.status: exact generated target draw contract resolved, including UNORM write/SRGB sample alias

strict_execution.policy: no zero/identity/table substitution and no reference-image fitting

minimal_exact_subset.scope: execute the complete Kestron MiiMask target: transparent clear, seven gated cases in pass0, the exact opaque-black fullscreen case21 draw, then the same seven cases in pass1, using the exact native constants, sprite mips, mesh streams, sampler, pipelines, and UNORM write view
minimal_exact_subset.not_in_scope: downstream GameUber Head/Hair/Body draws and their unresolved frame-owned inputs

capture_schema.purpose: future source/runtime capture boundary for inputs that this evidence-only ledger cannot derive

constant_buffer_capture.payload_rule: payload_artifact is the literal bound byte allocation; consumers may read only ledger-listed words, but may not synthesize missing required words
constant_buffer_capture.dynamic_env_rule: cbuf9 must be the complete 9024-byte allocation unless the captured gsys_user4 texels prove the complete selector set and every selected record is present

sampler_capture.rule: capture the actual view and every subresource reachable by the decoded shader; a dummy or clear texture is accepted only when this ledger marks that exact binding resolved

capture_schema.executable_decision: a selected program is executable only when strict_execution.executable is true; unresolved hard_fail_blockers are a complete machine-readable refusal reason
